correctness.rationale: The k-state upper bound follows by explicitly counting the k distinct endpoints in the cited MSD interval construction. For the lower bound, the exact Fibonacci rotation identity yields the parity-split single-Fibonacci perturbation table. Each of k-2 standard prefixes has a different last unary-zero output deviation; the exceptional prefix 4 or 6 differs from F_2 only at unary depth zero; zero has no deviation. All k residuals are distinct. The proof checks k>=5 and both parity boundaries. Standalone integer and Decimal computations independently corroborate the finite cases k=5..100 and 5..70.
